name: Utsumi Kali
source:
One of the inmates of SPHIA. She possesses extensive knowledge, especially in the field of psychology. She is the mood maker and the mediator of the group.

[spoiler]She bears a great hatred toward Inubushi Keiko.[/spoiler]
